msg: Good morning, we are two Belgian divers (both Advanced) staying at a hotel on Isla Grande from the 8th to the 12th. We would like to dive on two different days and do one night dive. We fly home from Cartagena on the 13th at 7 a.m. What do you recommend, and can we pay in euros in cash when we arrive?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good morning! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands. Since you’re already there, the **3-dive package** fits your plan: two daytime dives and one night dive in a single day. Daytime pick-up is around 9:30–9:45 a.m.; the night dive pick-up is around 5:30 p.m. Hotel pick-up depends on whether your hotel has boat access.

The night dive is on the first day, and the second day returns to Cartagena around 3:00 p.m. The 3-dive option also requires waiting at least 18 hours after diving before flying; the 5-dive option’s return timing would leave a very short interval before your 7 a.m. flight, so please check that timing with a team advisor before choosing it.

International guests pay **100% by card on the website**; payment in euros cash on arrival isn’t available. The online price includes the 10% online discount. If online payment fails, the team can send a bank-transfer payment link and the online discount is kept.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to help arrange the island-based dives and check the timing against your flight?

msg: We are certified and don't need the snorkeling. We leave the islands on the 12th and fly on the 13th at 7 a.m., and we could dive on the 9th and 10th, so why would the timing be short? Is there a package over two days that includes a night dive, and what does it cost?
reply:
You’re right—the timing isn’t short if you dive on the 9th and 10th and leave the islands on the 12th. I misunderstood your dates earlier; sorry about that.

The 4-dive package has two daytime dives on one day and one daytime dive plus the night dive on the other. The 5-dive package also includes a night dive. For the 5-dive package, the exact dive schedule can be confirmed by the team.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Which hotel or island are you staying at? That way we can arrange pickup.
